counterfactual_strength.help: (float) - Fraction of the diffusion noise schedule used for inversion, from 0 to 1. Lower values retain more of the source but may change the phenotype less. Zero leaves the crop unchanged. Used only by the diffusion counterfactual generator. Default 0.95.

counterfactual_structure_weight.help: (float) - Nonnegative weight of the diffusion training penalty for changes in spatial gradients at several scales. Uniform channel offsets are not penalized. This encourages layout retention but does not guarantee biological identity or phenotype success. Zero keeps denoising-only training. Used only by the diffusion counterfactual generator. Default 0.

counterfactual_checkpoint.help: (str) - Optional existing local diffusion checkpoint to reuse without training. Requires the diffusion generator and its expected SHA-256. The saved architecture, channels, preprocessing, classifier and condition identities must match the current run. Missing, legacy or incompatible metadata is refused; spaCR does not train a replacement. Blank keeps the existing training route. Default blank.

counterfactual_checkpoint_sha256.help: (str) - Expected 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of the selected local diffusion checkpoint. Required when a checkpoint is selected; ignored when the checkpoint path is blank. A matching checksum identifies the file but does not establish biological accuracy or independent validation. Default blank.
